name: Wilson
bio: The paper uses the name Wilson for at least three men: a Colorado ranchman in a reprinted story, a Mandan visitor in 1885, and a stock agent credited in October 1885. None is identified further.

moments.label: Stock agent Wilson credited for an expedition

mentions: A ranchman named Wilson, of Colorado, now said to be worth some $2,000,000 to $3,000,000, some twenty-five or thirty years ago made the trip to Pike's peak with a team or two of oxen, and which…
Messrs. Ingram and Wilson of Mandan were in town this week.
…e principal share of the credit, in connection with Mr. Hannaford, for this expedition, is due to Stock agent Wilson, than whom there is no one to whom we would sooner give it.
